heading: INT. ABANDONED BOWLING ALLEY - LANE NINE - NIGHT

units.text: INT. ABANDONED BOWLING ALLEY - LANE NINE - NIGHT
Neon pins flicker over a taped-off lane.
Underground curling, bowling stones on waxed lanes.
Cash piles on the ball return.
COACH ODALYS BRANCH (50s, ex-champion, cane) leans on the scorer's table.
HIRO TANABE (20s, wiry, wrapped wrists) chalks his hands.
His rival, DESMOND "DEZ" OYELARAN (20s, broad, grinning) stretches at the foul line.
BIG PAT (60s, bookie, cardigan) counts money.
LUCIA FERRARI (30s, referee, whistle on a bootlace) holds the stopwatch.
Final frame. Hiro needs a strike. Dez needs a spare.
units.name: LUCIA

units.text: I know what I need.
units.name: HIRO

units.text: Eyes on the headpin, not on him.
units.name: COACH BRANCH

units.text: He can look at me all he wants. He gave his uncle the same look before he lost.
units.name: DEZ

units.text: Say that again.
units.name: HIRO

units.text: Your uncle. Lost his house on this lane.
units.name: DEZ

units.text: Hiro, he is feeding you. Don't eat.
units.name: COACH BRANCH

units.text: Nobody is eating. Everybody is betting. Eat on your own time.
units.name: BIG PAT

units.text: Sixty seconds, Hiro.
units.name: LUCIA

units.text: Coach, he stood there when my uncle signed the paper. He smiled at him.
units.name: HIRO

units.text: Then he's smiling now because he's scared. He's scared, so he talks. You hear me?
units.name: COACH BRANCH

units.text: I'm scared of nothing in this building.
units.name: DEZ

units.text: Then you won't mind me doubling your side.
units.name: BIG PAT

units.text: Double it.
units.name: DEZ

units.text: Pat, you can't change the stake mid-frame.
units.name: LUCIA

units.text: I can change anything I like. It's my money, my lane, my building.
units.name: BIG PAT

units.text: It's the bank's building.
units.name: COACH BRANCH

units.text: The bank's cousin's building. Close enough.
units.name: BIG PAT

units.text: Lucia, start the clock.
units.name: HIRO

units.text: You sure?
units.name: LUCIA

units.text: He told me to wait for him last time. I waited. Start it.
units.name: HIRO

units.text: Then he walks the approach slow. Four steps. No fifth.
units.name: COACH BRANCH

units.text: Four. No fifth.
units.name: HIRO

units.text: He always takes a fifth.
units.name: DEZ

units.text: Not tonight.
units.name: COACH BRANCH

units.text: Clock's running. Fifty.
units.name: LUCIA

units.text: Everyone breathe.
units.name: BIG PAT

units.text: Dez.
units.name: HIRO

units.text: What.
units.name: DEZ

units.text: When I hit this, give my uncle the deed back.
units.name: HIRO

units.text: When you hit it.
units.name: DEZ

units.text: Forty.
units.name: LUCIA

units.text: Go.
units.name: COACH BRANCH
